invariants.rationale: The method accesses nodes.size and nodes.get(i), so nodes must not be null.
Array.size should be non-negative by definition.
If there is at least one element, nodes.get(0) should not be null since it is used as a Node.
collapseAll sets node.setExpanded(false) on every node, so after execution any node is not expanded.
collapseAll is recursively called on node.children; for this to be safe, children should not be null (assuming project conventions).
